acceptance_criteria.evidence: Not implemented by this candidate: the reintroduced-defect regression fixture belongs to the #412 recurring-defect gate already on main; PR #538 does not change that gate. It adds DFF-010 regressions only.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Not implemented by this candidate: the full-hostile-review readiness rule is the #412 pre-ready review gate already on main (DFF-013); PR #538 does not modify hunter_pre_ready_review.py or merge readiness.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: Not implemented by this candidate: stale-receipt and recurring-rule evidence are produced by existing receipt/registry machinery (DFF-012) that PR #538 does not change.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: an authorized coding agent can produce a multi-commit pr without manual rewind/force-push solely to satisfy per-commit actor evidence
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Not implemented by this candidate: range-level multi-commit publication evidence is DFF-011 machinery already on main; PR #538 does not change it.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: candidate admission rejects writer/committer mismatch before remote push and reports the exact mismatched provenance claim
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PR #538 extends the local pre-push writer binding (DFF-010) so the commit's actual SSH signing key (%GK, verified via %G?) must be bound to the writer its author/committer headers resolve to, read from the server-fresh canonical base tip rather than the candidate's own policy; a header/key mismatch such as the PR #535 unknown_key case is refused before remote push and the refusal names the exact commit, writer and key. Evidence: test_the_pr_535_identity_key_mismatch_is_refused_locally, test_signing_keys_and_parents_are_read_for_real_signed_commits, test_a_candidate_cannot_bind_its_own_signing_key, test_a_stale_cached_trusted_tip_fails_closed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: commit attribution to an implementation agent can coexist with the authorization-bound writer identity without weakening auditability
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Attribution stays in trailers and is never read as identity; the owner-recovery boundary lets the already-authorized owner take over a departed writer's range without re-attributing that writer's commits, with epochs decided by ancestry. Evidence: test_agent_attribution_trailer_cannot_rescue_an_unbound_identity, test_historical_attribution_before_the_boundary_is_not_reattributed, test_a_valid_owner_recovery_is_admitted, test_a_departed_writer_commit_that_merges_in_after_the_takeover_is_refused.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no auto-merge; separate owner merge approval remains mandatory
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Not implemented by this candidate: PR #538 does not touch merge controls; owner merge approval remains mandatory and unchanged.

defect_families.evidence: A recovery declaration binds its exact parent SHA and is read with git's trailer parser after identity and key are resolved, so it cannot be replayed onto another boundary; a gpgsig copied onto other content yields %G?=B and binds nothing (test_a_bound_key_on_a_signature_that_did_not_verify_binds_nothing).

Writer authority is read from git objects (%GK, %G?, %P, trailers) and the trusted tip's committed policy; candidate-edited policy and forged signatures are refused (test_a_candidate_cannot_bind_its_own_signing_key).
Connector ingress grant and its proof are unchanged; signing-key bindings authenticate the writer rather than restating caller-chosen headers.

Primary family. The signing key that actually signed each commit is bound to the resolved writer; authority comes from the server-fresh canonical base tip, never the candidate; owner recovery is a single owner-signed, parent-pinned, ancestry-checked boundary. See the DFF-010 regression_evidence list in docs/DEFECT_REGISTRY.json.

findings.evidence: Hosted CI: %GK read empty without gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile, so every commit read as unsigned on hosted runners. Regression: test_signing_keys_and_parents_are_read_for_real_signed_commits.
Hosted CI: real-signed test depended on unreachable PR #535 objects; replaced with an ephemeral-key fixture. Regression: test_signing_keys_and_parents_are_read_for_real_signed_commits.
Copilot: owner_writer.login was only checked to be a bound writer, not the repository owner. Regression: test_naming_another_bound_writer_as_owner_does_not_make_it_the_owner.
Copilot: %GK accepted without %G? signature-verification status. Regression: test_a_bound_key_on_a_signature_that_did_not_verify_binds_nothing.
Copilot: require_single_writer_per_range could be disabled in policy. Regression: test_single_writer_enforcement_cannot_be_switched_off_in_policy.
Copilot: commit-record parser accepted any field count of six or more. Regression: test_a_record_with_any_other_field_count_fails_closed.
Codex P1: one signing key could be bound to two writers. Regression: test_a_signing_key_bound_to_two_writers_fails_closed.
Codex P2: log.showSignature corrupted machine-readable git log output. Regression: test_signing_keys_and_parents_are_read_for_real_signed_commits.
Copilot+Codex P1: recovery epochs split by log position, not ancestry. Regression: test_a_departed_writer_commit_that_merges_in_after_the_takeover_is_refused.
Codex P1: check_range trusted candidate-edited signing-key bindings. Regression: test_a_candidate_cannot_bind_its_own_signing_key.
Codex P1: authority read from the historical fork point, not the current trusted tip. Regression: test_a_branch_forked_before_key_binding_meets_the_current_trusted_tip.
Copilot: a declared but malformed owner_recovery grant degraded to no recovery. Regression: test_a_declared_but_malformed_recovery_grant_fails_closed.
Codex P1 + Copilot: trusted tip read from a possibly stale local cache. Regression: test_a_stale_cached_trusted_tip_fails_closed.
Codex P1: fork clones read authority from origin instead of upstream. Regression: test_a_fork_clone_reads_authority_from_upstream.
Copilot: missing-policy test depended on a real origin/main ref. Regression: test_pre_push_fails_closed_without_repository_policy.
